TextBlock.Text: TIMOR CORRIDOR. A Chinese surface action group is working south-east down the corridor screening an amphibious transport, and it has begun turning merchant traffic back by radio and then by gun. You send one ship, alone, sixty miles on their disengaged bow with the weather in your favour and a full deck-launcher load. The four merchants you are covering are ten miles behind you at a tug's speed, and ESCORT SEVEN, the Meridian boat that tried to stop Coral Pioneer on the eighteenth, is on their track to hold them for the surface group. Establish the military threat, engage it, and be somewhere else when the counter-strike arrives - their JH-7A strike pair is within range of this box and their helicopter is already up. The merchants in the lane are not targets because somebody wrote SANCTIONED on a manifest.

Your ship has the shot. The Sovremenny fired on a protected convoy in daylight, and that changes what you may do to her. The convoy behind you is what the shot is for; the Type 071 transport is not. If she turns north, let her. Come out with rounds left - there is no reload before Monday's convoy.
Escort: Neutralise the Sovremenny screening the transport Convoy: Lose no more than one merchant, and not Coral Pioneer Magazine: Bring your ship out with anti-ship rounds left

One escort of your choice, with her anti-ship missiles and her flight. Opposing: a Sovremenny, a Type 071 with its Z-20J, a JH-7A pair, a Z-21 and Meridian Escort Seven. Four protected merchants behind you, two neutral ones ahead.
55 minutes. The operation ends when the clock runs out, and the main objective fails with it.
Destroying a neutral contact ends the operation in failure. Identify before you shoot.

U.S. Navy 2027 Capabilities mod, Chinese Navy (PLAN), PLAN Type 071 Amphibious Transport Dock, Red Storm Arsenal, XIAN JH-7A (歼轰-7A 飞豹), RE-power: the resupply mod, Merchants Expanded, Auxiliary Merchant Pack, RAAF F-35A Lightning II, the base game, this pack.
